summary.name: littleguys
summary.one_liner: A free, open source macOS app that lets you chat with your AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes) in a WhatsApp-style interface.
keywords: run ai agents from one window
use_cases: Chatting with multiple coding agents from one window
Approving or denying agent shell commands with one click
Monitoring agent status from the macOS menu bar
Scheduling recurring agent tasks like morning digests or nightly dependency bumps
Managing agents running across a Mac mini, homelab and laptop
summary.what_it_does: The app presents each AI agent as a contact with its own chat thread, supporting streaming replies, tool calls and attachments. Commands that need permission appear as cards where you can allow once, always allow, or deny. A menu bar icon shows agent activity and status, and clicking it lists every agent with a live status ring, last message and quick reply. Routines let you schedule recurring agent tasks with run-now and results posted to a thread. It finds gateways on your tailnet and LAN automatically and speaks the Agent Client Protocol to connect new agents from the ACP registry.
notable: Menu bar icon that visually reflects what each agent is doing
Talks directly to agents with no littleguys account and no cloud or telemetry
Built with a Rust core and React on Tauri; source is readable
Installable via .dmg, Homebrew, or a build-from-source script
caveats: Only macOS is named on the page
